verdict.rationale: The Ryzen AI software stack is scriptable: it offers Python/C++ ONNX Runtime APIs, the Lemonade SDK, an OpenAI-style server interface usable from any language, the xrt-smi command-line tool and Ubuntu/RHEL Linux support. These are the building blocks for unattended automation, but nothing explicitly documents headless or CI operation, so the fit is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit headless/CI deployment documentation, CI runner or container guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation.
